'''Sumire Morohoshi''' (Japanese: '''諸星すみれ''' ''Morohoshi Sumire'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Morohoshi was born on April 23, 1999, in {{wp|Ōi, Kanagawa}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as a child. She joined {{aniseries|PTS}} at the age of 14, during {{aniseries|BW}}; she voiced the [[Genesect Army|Douse Drive Genesect]] in [[M16|the sixteenth movie]]. After a years-long absence, she went on to regularly voice [[Acerola]] during {{aniseries|SM}}. Morohoshi is currently affiliated with the theatrical company {{wp|Himawari Theatre Group}}.
